verified: Nvidia's own press release, dated November 12, 2026, states that Jensen Huang resigned as President, CEO and a board member, that CFO Colette Kress was appointed interim CEO, and that Harvey C. Jones became the board's first-ever chair.
unconfirmed: The compensation details rest on Wired's account of an internal all-hands — that Kress promised raises and more equity on an accelerated schedule, with the bumps set for December rather than the normal raise cycle. Also unconfirmed are the reported letter from a director-level employee warning of an exodus of "irreplaceable talent," the reported pro-Huang faction on the board, and whether Huang could be reinstated; the sources do not give the size of the raises or the equity grants.

verified: Nvidia 董事会于 11 月 12 日宣布，联合创始人黄仁勋辞去总裁、首席执行官及董事会成员职务，任命执行副总裁兼首席财务官 Colette Kress 为临时 CEO，并任命 Harvey C. Jones 为公司首位董事会主席（Nvidia 新闻稿，多家科技媒体同日报道）。据《连线》报道，Kress 在 11 月 18 日的全员会上承诺 12 月上调薪酬并增发股权，时间远早于公司常规调薪周期，并称薪酬与董事会的进一步说明是员工会前提问最集中的两个话题。
unconfirmed: 加薪与股权的具体幅度、覆盖范围均未披露；黄仁勋辞职的原因及董事会的决策过程没有官方说明；董事会“不打算让黄仁勋回归”以及“董事会内部存在支持黄仁勋的派系”均来自媒体报道，后者更仅见于单一报道；一名总监级员工致信董事会与高管、警告“不可替代的人才”可能流失，同样只有一家媒体的转述；全员会内容目前仅来自《连线》对会议的描述，Nvidia 未公开会议记录。

titles.en: Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress pledges December pay raises after Huang ouster, Wired reports
titles.zh: 黄仁勋辞职后英伟达首次全员会：临时CEO承诺12月加薪并增发股权
